decision: The competitor (Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: The driver did not attend the post race media commitments.
offence: Breach of Article B10.1.4e of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative that the driver had left the circuit without attending the post race media commitments. Noting that the Stewards can proceed to make a determination in the case of a non attendance at a hearing, a penalty of €5,000 is imposed on the competitor.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 63 Failure To Attend Mandatory Post Race Commitments
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
